svg.text: Performed experimental precedent for generated complete reactions
Selected cases; complete net chemistry, not experimentally established electron-arrow sequences.
US7173043B2, Example 27.4 / 27.1: benzothiophenol + 1,4-dibromobutane; K2CO3 / acetone, 45 C, 10 h; excess dibromide
removed in vacuo. MS 378 (M, 1 Br). No individual yield or purity reported; not the isothiazole or three-carbon-linker
US5110940, Example 108: allylic alcohol 2.2 g + activated MnO2 7 g, CH2Cl2 100 mL, 20 h; temperature unspecified.
Reported quantitative yield and mp 208 C (decomp). Elemental-analysis discrepancy retained; no numerical isolated yield
or purity claim. N2-trityl tetrazole and diaryl alkene retained.
Source/training overlap unknown; an experimentally documented transformation is not a tested whole route.
